name: vllm-sr
description: Plugins from the vLLM Semantic Router project for GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: vsr-copilot
plugins.description: vLLM Semantic Router's decision model beside GitHub Copilot CLI: guard holds risky shell commands, redact hides personal data in command output, and shield flags output that tries to give the agent orders.

plugins.name: vsr
plugins.description: Routes subagents by difficulty, escalates when you push back, redacts personal data and secrets, shields against prompt injection, guards risky Bash commands, and checks answers against what Claude read. Run /vsr:setup after installing.
